title: yayPi Jobs
description: Defines scheduled background jobs using cron expressions.

name.description: Unique job name used in logs and monitoring.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this job does.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the schedule. Defaults to UTC.

handler.description: sql: run config.sql. http: call config.url (with optional headers, body, secret + signature). plugin: run the JobHandlerPlugin job named by plugin.

plugin.description: <plugin>.<job> to run for handler: plugin (registered with Server.RegisterJobs).

config.description: Handler settings. sql: sql, database. http: url, method, headers, body (string, or a map sent as JSON), allowed_hosts, allow_private_network, secret, signature (same block as webhooks). plugin: passed to the job as JobContext.Config.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time. Job is cancelled if exceeded.

on_failure.description: log (default: failures are logged) or <plugin>.<job> run once after the last attempt fails; JobContext.Failure describes the failure.

RetryConfig.description: Retry settings for failed job executions.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of execution attempts (including the first).

initial_delay.description: Wait time before the first retry.

max_delay.description: Maximum wait time between retries (caps exponential backoff).
